name: CMSB
recent: Cahya Mata Sarawak 公布 2026 年第三季度业绩，季度净利同比下滑 72%，主要受磷酸盐工厂重启成本及行政开支影响；不过 9 个月累计营收同比增长 14.3%，净利增长 20.5%。公司同时出现审计委员会及董事会人事变动。
notable: 2026 年第三季度净利同比下滑 72%，受磷酸盐工厂重启成本及行政开支影响。
2026 年 9 个月累计营收同比增长 14.3% 至 RM912.2 mil，净利增长 20.5% 至 RM55.6 mil。
GEE SIEW YOONG 辞任审计委员会成员及董事会职务。
risks: 季度净利同比大幅下滑 72%，受磷酸盐工厂重启成本及行政开支拖累。
公司董事及审计委员会成员出现变动。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 RM291.974 mil，环比增长 4.9%，同比增长 18.2%；净利为 RM22.441 mil，环比下降 6.8%，净利率 7.7%，低于上季度的 8.6%。

recent_en: Cahya Mata Sarawak reported a 72% year-on-year drop in 3Q 2026 net profit, mainly due to phosphate plant restart costs and administrative expenses, while 9M revenue rose 14.3% and net profit grew 20.5%. The company also saw changes in its audit committee and boardroom.
notable_en: 3Q 2026 net profit fell 72% year-on-year, affected by phosphate plant restart costs and administrative expenses.
9M 2026 revenue rose 14.3% year-on-year to RM912.2 mil, with net profit up 20.5% to RM55.6 mil.
GEE SIEW YOONG ceased to be a member of the audit committee and the board.
risks_en: Quarterly net profit fell 72% year-on-year, dragged by phosphate plant restart costs and administrative expenses.
Changes occurred in the company's board and audit committee membership.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM291.974 mil, up 4.9% qoq and 18.2% yoy; net income was RM22.441 mil, down 6.8% qoq, with a net margin of 7.7% versus 8.6% in the previous quarter.
